fuel_consumption.source_quote: No fuel consumption stated. Branded operations (Midwest Airlines, acquired 2009) were not yet consolidated. Fixed-fee CPA operations: fuel pass-through.

instrument_type_details.notes: No fuel hedging for FY2008. Republic operates under fixed-fee CPAs where fuel is a pass-through cost. Item 7A covers only interest rate risk. Republic acquired Midwest Airlines in 2009 and Frontier Airlines Holdings out of bankruptcy in 2009; fuel hedging began for branded operations in subsequent years.

warnings: Regional carrier operating under CPAs — fuel is pass-through; no fuel hedging program.
Republic subsequently acquired Midwest Airlines (2009) and Frontier Airlines (out of bankruptcy, 2009), beginning fuel hedging for branded operations.

throughput.source_quote: Fuel gallons consumed: 101,998,657 (fiscal year ended December 31, 2008) from Item 7 operating statistics table. Average price per gallon $3.21 in 2008 vs $2.40 in 2007.
